prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind her, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Brazilian person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, an elegant handsome young male face with a high nose bridge, a defined jaw, straight brows and a strong neck, clean-shaven, sharp black graphic eyeliner with matte nude lips and defined contour, smooth warm bronze skin, a gentle soft smile, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large copper hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a copper square-sided cowbell, a tin hammer head, a bronze pyramid-shaped lump, a gold small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three gold hair ornaments. Extremely long round nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.

LEFT Body Art: Her body carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme gold ankle-strap stilettos with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Extremely long coffin nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

It is fused to his own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
